title: Smogcast: Self-Monitoring PM2.5 Forecasts for Delhi NCR
description: 24 h and 48 h PM2.5 forecasts where the platform matters more than the model: an outage-safe hourly collector, PSI/KS drift checks, drift-triggered retraining behind a promotion gate, a registry with canary deploys and 0.06 s rollback, MLflow tracking and a FastAPI server exporting Prometheus metrics. The model beats persistence by 10% at 24 h (26.4 vs 29.4 µg/m³ MAE) on CAMS model data. A 120-week walk-forward replay found drift-triggered retraining did not beat blind 28-day refits, and the README says so.
